backend/main.mo: Motoko canister managing media uploads, user profiles, and live sessions with access control and blob-storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, and test identifiers.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of key frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining OKLCH theme variables for light and dark modes and global styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry file mounting the root element and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routes, theme provider, and an initial splash screen.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper with navbar, footer, and authenticated-only floating action button.
frontend/src/components/AuthControls.tsx: Authentication button component handling login/logout via Internet Identity and cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/EmptyState.tsx: Reusable empty-state display with icon, title, and description.
frontend/src/components/FloatingActionBu: Signed-in-only floating action button opening a menu for uploading videos/shorts or starting live sessions.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, navigation links, community info, and a dynamic copyright line.
frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx: Displays the top navigation bar with links, user status, and authentication controls.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Provides a modal for users to enter and save their display name on first setup.
frontend/src/components/ShortCard.tsx: Shows a preview card for a short video with thumbnail, title, and duration.
frontend/src/components/SplashScreen.tsx: Renders a full‑screen splash image during app loading.
frontend/src/components/UploadForm.tsx: Implements a media upload form supporting videos and shorts with metadata extraction and progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Displays a card for a full video with thumbnail, title, duration, and upload date.
frontend/src/components/VideoPlayer.tsx: Custom video player with play, volume, seek, and fullscreen controls, exposing a pause method via ref.
frontend/src/components/ViewerTimer.tsx: React timer component that counts down between user-defined start and end times and triggers a callback when finished.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes related queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, and logout handling using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating media, profiles, uploads, and live session data via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup with light/dark theme variables and base utility styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that displays all videos, handles loading, and prompts authenticated users to complete their profile.
frontend/src/pages/LiveDetailsPage.tsx: Page showing details for a specific live session with owner controls to end the session and status indicators.
frontend/src/pages/LivePage.tsx: Implements the live sessions page, allowing authenticated users to start a new live session and view active ones, with profile setup gating.
frontend/src/pages/ShortsPage.tsx: Fetches and displays all shorts in a grid, showing a loading spinner or empty state when needed.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx: Handles media upload access, showing a login prompt for guests and rendering the upload form for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/WatchPage.tsx: Loads and plays a selected video or short with metadata and integrates a viewer timer that can pause playback.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session-based parameters, including hash support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind CSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and content scanning paths for the frontend.
project_state.json: Describes the OmniStream project’s current state, implemented features, requirements, and architectural notes.
